verdict_reason: The template's change works (stub link stays /auth/sign-in, IDM link is tested in idm-sign-in.test.js:143), but it leaves a stale cross-module comment, splits the try-again destination between controller and template default, and names one value two ways.

todos.issue: The comment on line 5 ('Destination, not copy, so it lives here rather than in copy.en.js/copy.cy.js — identical in both locales.') describes other modules (the copy files) and gives rationale, which the house rules keep out of code. The diff also makes it untrue: the destination now comes from the view model's signInUrl, and only the stub fallback lives here.
todos.fix: Must: the template has no comment that describes other modules or gives rationale. Any rationale worth keeping is in the repo's docs/ (architecture.md:73-75 already describes the try-again link). One way: delete the comment.

todos.issue: The try-again destination now has two owners. idm-sign-in.js:58-60 passes signInUrl: idmPaths.signIn in its view model, while the four stub renders in controller.js (lines 34, 44, 55, 75) pass nothing and rely on the template's hard-coded default '/auth/sign-in' (unauthorised.njk:6). The template picks a route, and the stub sign-in path is written again here beside its owner in auth/index.js:11 and stub-sign-in.js:72.
todos.fix: Must: each controller that renders auth/unauthorised says where its try-again link goes, and the template only renders the URL it is given, with no route literal of its own. One way: have controller.js pass signInUrl from a stub path constant (shared with auth/index.js) and drop the default filter from the template.

todos.issue: One value, two names: the view model key is signInUrl (idm-sign-in.js:60, architecture.md:75) and the template renames it to tryAgainUrl on line 6, so a reader following the link href back to the controller has to map between them.
todos.fix: Must: the try-again link's destination has one name from the controller's view model to the href. One way: name the view model key for what the link does (tryAgainUrl, or keep signInUrl) and use that name in the template with no local alias.
